title: Beta 6 performs worse than Beta 5 for me – Could it be my ComfyUI workflow?

latest.raw:
I've been having some issues with Beta 6. Beta 5 works significantly better for me, especially when it comes to prompt following and motion accuracy. Beta 6 looks slightly more realistic, but it struggles to follow my prompts properly.
Since many people are saying that Beta 6 is a big improvement over Beta 5, I'm wondering if the problem might be my ComfyUI workflow or settings.
I'd really like to try different workflows and see if I can get better results.
[I am using I2V and not T2V]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Could someone share a working Beta 6 ComfyUI workflow (.json)?

latest.raw: Most should be taking my word and the comments more seriously and looking at their sampling, workflow and prompt. You have an issue there and I'm gonna start pushing back on model blamers. "Adherence", which is extremely broad by the way, can be a sampling shift cause or undersampling. b6 runs with 10/3 shift, 10 video shift while the normal model and b5 run 12.  That's not suggested, it's required. It is literally built with full reference timestep and even has viggle in it. I've done video replacement, continuation, audio, music video lipsync, mixed multiple video references together, i2v done with reference node, 8 image reference composed outputs all perfectly fine and way beyond what 5 could do which is more or less just fl2va level.

latest.raw:
> Could you share your workflow?

Not sure which one BalorDMN is using, but you might want to take a look at the sample one I posted for my Beta6 quants on my repo (link just a few messages above this one). With proper prompting it does i2v perfectly fine. Small identity/context drift on long videos is inevitable in i2v as that's a H3 base issue. That exactly is the reason why proper ref2av mode or the now common refmods exist. Anyway, a properly set up workflow shouldn't be worse for i2v in Eros Beta6 than it was on beta5 or base Fast H3 in this regard.

Look at this post for some guidelines from TenStrip for proper i2v anchoring:
https://huggingface.co/TenStrip/10Eros-Max/discussions/63#6acd1e8d38e2e5318c1efa43
